reviews.title: Customer Service Not Responsive
reviews.text: I have the paid version and previously loved it, but after getting a new phone, I logged in with Apple ID and it will not associate my subscription with the new device, so I paid $79 for the year and can’t use it. I’ve emailed customer service multiple times and cannot get a resolution.

reviews.title: Needs More Improvement
reviews.text: The app works for basic teleprompting, but the overall experience wasn't very impressive. It feels a bit limited, and some features aren't as intuitive as I expected. I also found the interface a little confusing at times. With better usability and a few more improvements, it could be a much better app.

reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text: I resubscribed because I wanted to make videos after my break I took and I can’t use it. Every time I try it just keeps bringing me back to the purchases screen. I would like my money back since this isn’t going to work. Useless…
